invariant_D.definition: D=beta0(48)-beta0(64), beta0(V)=beta_c(V)+F(8)-F(8*x_match,V), with x_match defined by J15(x)=J3 independently of the Fig.15 temperature axis.
invariant_D.invariance_scope: Invariant to common additive F->F+c and common anchor changes; not invariant to local calibration slope/shape, volume-dependent estimator systematics, or unknown covariance.

common_anchor.interpretation: Three anchor handles agree within about 1 sigma under the illustrative rho=0 GLS error model. This reduces concern about a common additive anchor, but does not establish the authors' exact Fig.15 convention.

covariance_refinement.model: rho_hc correlates hot/cold Fig.15; rho_153 correlates Fig.15 and Fig.3; rho_x correlates the volumes.
covariance_refinement.rho_grid_proposal: Pre-register full 2D grid rho_hc x rho_153 at rho_x=0; do not select rho by resulting significance; account for look-elsewhere if scanning.
covariance_refinement.interpretation: All rho are illustrative, not measured. rho_153 may be substantial if Fig.15 and Fig.3 share ensembles/reweighting; rho_hc=0.9 is an aggressive bracket if phase samples are separated.
covariance_refinement.non_independence: D contrast and one-parameter GLS common-shift residual are the same one-dimensional contrast when built from the same covariance matrix; do not count as independent evidence.
covariance_refinement.numeric_consistency_note: Displayed values are close but not identical: zD^2=1.218 vs GLS chi2_min=1.241 (rho=0); 4.460 vs 4.545 (rho=0.9). Recompute both from one unrounded covariance matrix before asserting exact numerical identity.

method_systematics.concern: D is anchor-free but not free of volume-dependent difference between Fig.15 phase-resolved estimator and Fig.3 peak/reweighting estimator.
method_systematics.consequence: Flow-time/finite-volume and estimator cross-checks logically precede interpreting D as a temperature-calibration discrepancy. Even author covariance alone does not isolate calibration error until estimator systematics are bounded.

additional_controls.fig3_full_flow_series: FIGURES.json currently has Fig.15 hot/cold 30+30 nodes per volume at t/a^2=1.4, while Fig.3 is digitized only at t=0 and 1.4. Proposed: digitize full Fig.3 t-series from EPS and form a bracket under explicit assumption of equal flow-time correction for both estimators; not a direct D(t) measurement.

fig13_vs_fig3.status: Preliminary; verify triangle markers, matching, flow time and scheme before use. Potential axis-free estimator cross-check.

fig16_cold64_last_point.status: Digitization-review candidate only; not established artifact.

additional_controls.calibration_curve_quantization: Repeated identical beta coordinates at different n and global fit residual ~0.000242 may reflect vector rendering/quantization rather than physical noise. Degree-5 form is the published Eq.(42) central form; other degrees are sensitivity brackets. Local slope near n=8 is more relevant to D than a high-order global fit.
